title: FAIR calls out some of the shoddy coverage on the 2025 Coup...
content: FAIR calls out some of the shoddy coverage on the 2025 Coup by the NY Times & Wash. Post. They “largely buried these stories, downplaying their earth-shattering break from democratic norms”. (Wired & Rolling Stone have been courageous in their coverage.)
author: Jason Kottke
